id: # han_196: the column name_zh has the new names of text/zh-TW.tsv of this pack. The rules of the rows are the rules of data/placeholder.
# The battlefield plots of plots-and-states.md (manual p.17, p.34; guide book p.18). One row for each plot.
# morale, range: documented. area: single, or splash (the target and the six hexes around it). target: enemy, own, hex.
# effect: fire, extinguish, false_report, confuse, calm, ambush, infighting, sorcery, lightning. turns: the length of the state (documented 3 for 偽報; the others assumed, Q-173).

# needs_skill, needs_skill_2: the skills (skills.md numbers) of which the unit needs one (妖術 #71, 鬼門 #72); 0 = none. from_terrain: the terrain key of the unit's hex, or -. not_unit_types: classes that cannot use it.
